title: Best Suitcase (2026)
summary: The guide lists five hard‑shell suitcases that have been highlighted by trusted travel reviewers.
method: Products were selected from Consumer Reports, Cruise & Travel, Condé Nast Traveler, and Good Housekeeping reviews.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

products.name: Samsonite
why: Samsonite was named Best Overall by Good Housekeeping.
It is a hard‑shell carry‑on that meets airline requirements and has smooth wheels.
products.desc: Samsonite is a hard‑shell carry‑on with smooth wheels and a durable design that meets airline carry‑on rules.
products.benefit: Picture a business traveler who needs a reliable carry‑on that can handle frequent flights. Samsonite offers a durable hard‑shell design that meets airline carry‑on rules and has smooth wheels for easy maneuverability. It outperforms other picks in this guide for overall durability and wheel smoothness. The catch: it is heavier than some of the lighter alternatives.
products.skip_if: You need a very lightweight carry‑on

products.name: Away
why: Away was named Best Carry‑On by Good Housekeeping.
It offers a hard‑shell carry‑on with modern features.
products.desc: Away is a hard‑shell carry‑on that includes modern features such as a built‑in charger and a sleek design.
products.benefit: Picture a tech‑savvy traveler who wants a carry‑on that can keep devices charged. Away offers a hard‑shell design with a built‑in charger and smooth wheels, making it convenient for long trips. It outshines other carry‑ons in this guide for built‑in charging. The catch: it is more expensive than some alternatives.

products.name: Briggs & Riley
why: Briggs & Riley was named Best for International Travel by Good Housekeeping.
It offers a hard‑shell carry‑on suitable for long international trips.
products.desc: Briggs & Riley is a hard‑shell carry‑on designed for international travel, featuring durable construction and ample space.
products.benefit: Picture a long‑haul traveler who needs a sturdy carry‑on that can survive multiple flights. Briggs & Riley provides a hard‑shell design with robust construction and plenty of space, making it ideal for international trips. It wins against other options in this guide for durability on long journeys. The catch: it is heavier than some lighter models.

verdict.line: Picture a business traveler who needs a reliable carry‑on that can handle frequent flights. Samsonite offers a durable hard‑shell design that meets airline carry‑on rules and has smooth wheels for easy maneuverability. The catch: it is heavier than some of the lighter alternatives.
